tickerText: [TENNIS] Jannik Sinner and Novak Djokovic withdraw from the National Bank Open in Montreal as Luca Van Assche stuns Andrey Rublev to reach Estoril semis • [SQUASH] Om Semwal, Sandhesh Ravikumar and Rathika Seelan advance to PSA Singapore Challenger quarterfinals • [BADMINTON] China Open semifinals day in Changzhou features Wang Zhiyi vs Akane Yamaguchi and Chen Yufei vs Tomoka Miyazaki • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open weekend action continues at Sports Arina with Collin Johns and Len Yang in the field • [TABLE TENNIS] Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi reach mixed doubles semifinals at WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos

newsItems.title: Sinner and Djokovic Skip Montreal
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner and Novak Djokovic have withdrawn from the National Bank Open, leaving Alexander Zverev and Félix Auger-Aliassime as top seeds.

newsItems.title: China Open Semifinals Day
newsItems.excerpt: Wang Zhiyi faces Akane Yamaguchi and Chen Yufei meets Tomoka Miyazaki as the Super 1000 in Changzhou reaches the last four across all five categories.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open Weekend
newsItems.excerpt: The inaugural PPA Asia 500 at Sports Arina enters its final days with Collin Johns, Len Yang and top Asian pros chasing ranking points and prize money.

newsItems.title: Calderano and Bruna Into Mixed Semis
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 2 mixed pair Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi beat Guilherme Teodoro and Giulia Takahashi 3-1 to reach the semifinals in São José dos Campos.
